evidence.support: The part asks which inward supplies are liable under reverse charge, applying the levy and collection rules that shift tax payment to the recipient.
The December liability assessment uses the invoice, payment, and receipt timing for a reverse-charge goods purchase, which falls under time of supply of goods.

mappings.note: The main task is identifying reverse-charge liability; the dated goods transaction also makes the reverse-charge time-of-supply rule relevant to the December period.
